cases.title: The baseline package passes at every hop
cases.when: The valid package is verified by the CLI, Control upload, Tool Host before mount and client before mount
then: Accepted at every hop with the digest in expected.json

cases.title: A package with an entry named ../evil is rejected
cases.when: The zip-slip package is verified at every hop
then: Rejected at every hop, before anything is extracted or mounted
Nothing is repaired automatically

cases.title: Sandboxes mount only from the content-addressed store
cases.when: The package file is replaced on disk after verification and before mount
then: The mounted bytes are the verified ones

cases.title: Base images must be signed by a trusted image signer
cases.when: A pool prepares an image unsigned, signed by an untrusted signer, and signed by a trusted signer
then: Only the last is used

cases.title: A valid signature never replaces digest checks
cases.when: A correctly signed package has an unlisted file
then: Rejected
